Configure liter-llm to extract text with a vision-capable model

```elixir title="Elixir"
input_value = %Xberg.ExtractInput{kind: "uri", mime_type: "image/png", uri: "https://example.com/images/test_hello_world.png"}
result = Xberg.extract_async(input_value, "{\"force_ocr\":true,\"ocr\":{\"backend\":\"vlm\",\"enabled\":true,\"language\":[\"eng\"],\"vlm_config\":{\"model\":\"openai/gpt-4o-mini\",\"temperature\":0.0}}}")
IO.inspect(Enum.at(result.results, 0).content)
```
